body_markdown:
October 7, 2026


## Coming together as One Teekay with unity, play and #TeekaySPIRIT at our annual Sportsfest.


From basketball, pickleball and badminton tournaments to tug of war, limbo rock and family activities, the event brought our colleagues together beyond their day-to-day roles.


Beyond the games and awards, Sportsfest reminded us that the strongest victories come from the friendships we build, the memories we create, and the spirit of unity that brings us together as One Teekay.
